error.reason: the stream is the zero Stream: start from an input (input.Video(), input.Audio()) or a join (goav.Mix(...))
fixes: start each stream from an input or a join: input.Video(), input.Audio(), goav.Mix(a, b)
route every stream with .To(destination) and pass the Outputs to rt.Run(ctx, outputs...)

error.reason: the stream's input was not constructed: use goav.FileInput, goav.Input, or goav.Source
fixes: start each stream from an input or a join: input.Video(), input.Audio(), goav.Mix(a, b)
route every stream with .To(destination) and pass the Outputs to rt.Run(ctx, outputs...)

error.reason: decoded frames cannot be written to a muxed output without an encoder
fixes: leave out .Decode() to copy the packets: input.Video().To(output)

error.reason: resize needs decoded frames, but a stream without .Decode() copies its packets
fixes: call .Decode() before .Resize(...), .Resample(...), or .Do(...) — transforms run on decoded frames
remove the processing step to keep a pure packet copy
reuse the Stream to fork a packet copy and a processed stream: s.To(copy), s.Decode()...To(out)
run the Outputs on a runtime: rt.Run(ctx, outputs...)
build a bare runtime with goav.New(...)
import github.com/thesyncim/goav/bundle and build with bundle.MustNew(...), bundle.Build(ctx, outputs...), or bundle.Run(ctx, outputs...)
